Source: [pkg/reasoning/modelanalyzer/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/pkg/reasoning/modelanalyzer/doc.go).

Package modelanalyzer is the production [reasoning.Analyzer](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Analyzer): it connects a model client to the read-only MCP tools for one pinned analysis and retries failed attempts.

Each attempt opens a fresh in-memory MCP session over the same [reasoning.ContextProvider](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#ContextProvider) and runs [reasoning.AnalyzeCandidateWithTools](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#AnalyzeCandidateWithTools). Only transport, MCP, and decoding errors are retried; a policy rejection is a successful analysis with a rejected outcome and is never retried into a different answer. Because every attempt sees the same pinned packet and graph digest, a retry cannot observe newer state. When all attempts fail, the error stops the reasoning service; see [reasoning.Service.Run](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#Service.Run).
